title: Estimating Propagated Error in Sphere Volume
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The radius of a sphere is measured as r = 10 cm with maximum measurement error dr = +-0.05 cm. Estimate the maximum propagated error and percentage error in the calculated volume.

steps.title: Find Differential of Volume
steps.explanation: Differentiate volume with respect to radius.

steps.title: Compute Propagated Error dV
steps.why: Linear estimation of measurement error propagation.

steps.title: Compute Relative and Percentage Error
steps.explanation: Notice the relative error in volume is exactly 3 times the relative error in radius.
steps.why: For power V proportional to r^3, relative error multiplies by exponent 3.
